description: Concat-residual LUT chain. E=16 token emb, O=16 out_proj output. Each block appends its out_proj output to its input (DenseNet-style growth). At L>=1, QK and V LUT inputs are bipartitioned: zoneA=[0..15] (token-emb slot), zoneB=[16..end] (accumulated prior outputs); pairs sampled within zones only. Inter-block residuals are real-valued; before the unembedder, the final 112-dim concat is rank-canonicalized via V2D->D2V. n_steps=8000, out_tph=1024 flat.
